title: Israeli Forces Raid Multiple Locations in Occupied West Bank
detail: Israeli forces conducted raids across multiple locations in the occupied West Bank, according to local sources, continuing a pattern of military operations in the territory. The operations targeted several communities amid ongoing Israeli military activity across the West Bank.

media.caption: Israeli forces raid multiple locations in the occupied West Bank

title: Palestinian Ambassador Hails UK Diplomatic Shift as 'Very Real'
detail: The Palestinian ambassador to the UK welcomed the British government's shift in stance on Israel, describing it as 'very real, not just words,' signalling a meaningful diplomatic realignment in London's approach to the Israel-Palestine conflict.
